_comment: Which versions of the PawnIO kernel driver heatlog is willing to read
hardware through. heatlog fetches this file before it uses PawnIO, so a
version can be blocked without releasing a new heatlog. The URL is fixed:
format        - bump only for a breaking change. A heatlog that does not
recognise the number stops using PawnIO rather than
guessing, so adding fields keeps format 1.
minimum_safe  - the oldest PawnIO heatlog will talk to.
blocked       - exact versions to refuse, each with a reason shown to the
user. '2.2.0' and '2.2.0.0' are the same version.
ignore_cves   - advisories that name PawnIO but do not apply, so one
unrelated CVE cannot disable the feature for everyone.
heatlog also refuses PawnIO when Windows will not load it, when the NVD
lists an advisory naming it, and when heatlog itself has had no release
for over a year. Those checks need no edits here.
